name: tensorboard_default_config
notes:
TensorBoard default launch configuration:

Default port: 6006
Default logdir: ./logs
Default host: localhost

Common launch patterns:
- tensorboard --logdir=<path> (uses port 6006)
- tensorboard --logdir=<path> --port=<custom_port>
- tensorboard --logdir=<path> --host=0.0.0.0 --port=<port>

Port conflict detection: TensorBoard will fail with 'Address already in use' error if port 6006 is occupied. Does not auto-select alternative port.

name: jupyter_notebook_config
notes:
Jupyter Notebook default configuration:

Default port: 8888
Config file: ~/.jupyter/jupyter_notebook_config.py
Default browser: auto-open in system default browser

Port behavior: If port 8888 is occupied, Jupyter will automatically try 8889, 8890, etc. until it finds an available port.

Common launch:
- jupyter notebook (uses port 8888 or next available)
- jupyter notebook --port=<custom_port>
- jupyter notebook --no-browser --port=<port>

name: gpu_quota_tracking
notes: Tracks GPU-hour consumption against quarterly allocations for interns and full-time engineers. Sends automated alerts at 75%, 90%, and 100% quota thresholds. Integrates with finance service for billing and compute cluster scheduler for quota enforcement. Q1 2026 intern tier allocation: 520 GPU-hours. Q2 2026 allocation activates April 1.
